dc:description: One saved result family × specification; each family retains its native paired measures and methodological context.
dc:title: Destination saved contrasts
notes: All cells are described as lexical strings to preserve source decimal precision and codes. Parse measures using units and status fields.

A blank CSV cell alone does not identify missingness: valid blank keys, structurally inapplicable fields and unavailable values are distinguished by the dataset contract, status columns and companion JSON.
Source units and values are unchanged; the interface converts probabilities to percentages only for display.

Field bindings: gap_measure: outside_minus_college_gap_pp; retain outside_gap_pp,college_gap_pp,hc3_se_pp,normal_approx_two_sided_p,n_known_industry,inference_scope; standardized_measures: connected_standardized_pct,no_identified_connection_standardized_pct,standardized_difference_pp,crude_known_industry_difference_pp,target; industry_measures: connected_percent,no_identified_connection_percent,difference_percentage_points,naics_groups,research_score_threshold
Reuse terms remain source-specific; see the dataset manifest and released access notices.
